# Retired credits: contributors removed from the Credits section of README.md on purpose,
# e.g. because their contribution was reverted or replaced, or at their own request.
# The Credit guard doesn't report the removal of anyone listed here.
# One GitHub login per line, optionally followed by a comment with the reason.
#
# Read from the base branch (pull requests) or from the commit before a push, and in forks
# also from the original repository's default branch. Add the entry first, then remove the credit.
